skill_domain: LLM evaluation, self-improvement, oracle quality, skill engineering

findings.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
findings.key_finding: LLM-as-judge achieves >80% agreement with human judgments; position bias and verbosity bias require multi-step mitigation; GPT-4 as judge is reliable for most domains
findings.design_impact: invoke_skill_judge + judge_calibration 双向校验机制的理论基础

findings.title: Overcoming Catastrophic Forgetting in Neural Networks (EWC)
findings.key_finding: Important weights can be protected via elastic constraints; less important weights can be freely updated; tiered protection prevents catastrophic forgetting
findings.design_impact: P0/P1/P2 分级：P0 case 是最重要的弹性约束，不可归档；P2 是可自由更新的历史约束

findings.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
findings.key_finding: Self-critique quality determines Constitutional AI effectiveness; critique prompts need explicit principles to be effective; iterative refinement via critique is scalable
findings.design_impact: judge_calibration 强制 judge_prompt 通过双向校准，相当于给 critique prompt 加 unit test

findings.title: Step-Level Value Preference Optimization for Mathematical Reasoning
findings.key_finding: Output-level reward models cannot localize step-level errors; per-step rubrics significantly improve attribution accuracy and training signal quality
findings.design_impact: v0 已知局限 → v1 方向 1（invoke_step_judge）：当前 judge 是 output-level，无法定位步骤

findings.title: Automated Assessment of the Quality of Test Oracles in LLM-Based Evaluation
findings.source: Molina & Gorla, 2024, software engineering automated testing
findings.key_finding: Bidirectional calibration (good→PASS and bad→FAIL) is both necessary and sufficient to validate oracle quality; unidirectional validation leaves systematic biases undetected
findings.design_impact: judge_calibration 的双向校验逻辑：good_example→PASS 验证不过严，bad_example→FAIL 验证不过宽

top_insights: LLM-as-judge 需要双向校验才能保证 oracle 质量，单向验证无法检测系统偏差
分级保护约束（EWC / P0/P1/P2）是解决 only-increase 约束空间增长的关键机制
step-level 评判比 output-level 评判有更强的归因能力，是 v1 的首要攻克方向

suggested_eval_cases.description: judge_calibration 断言能双向区分优质和劣质输出
